Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. Outputs Write the standard review artifacts: - `outputs/pr_review.json` — structured data with `recommendation`, `summary`, `inlineComments`, `issueCounts` - `outputs/pr_review_general.md` — 1-2 paragraph general PR comment - `outputs/pr_review_comments/*.md` — one file per detailed inline comment **Inline comment lines must be present in the PR diff.** GitHub review threads can only be attached to added or context lines inside a diff hunk. If `pr_diff.txt` is truncated, run `git diff origin/{baseBranch}...HEAD` to locate the correct line numbers. Findings on unchanged code outside the diff belong in `outputs/pr_review_general.md`, not as inline comments. Do NOT write `outputs/response.md`; the review is posted to GitHub only. ```mermaid flowchart TD O1["Write outputs/pr_review.json — structured data for GitHub PR review…

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1582
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1582
- **Title**: gh-1577 [GOAL] Empty completion after truncated stream is a retryable hiccup, never a silent exit 0 (B2)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1577` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 10
- **Additions**: +983
- **Deletions**: -40
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:03:44Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T10:44:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1577
## gh-1577 — Empty completion after truncated stream is a retryable hiccup, never a silent exit 0

### What changed
- An empty assistant completion that follows partial content (assistant text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is now a **bounded-retry provider hiccup** in the agent loop; on retry exhaustion the run ends with a loud `StopReason.error` naming the hiccup, attempt count and last stop reason — headless `-p` exits 1, interactive prints the error and returns to the prompt. The silent exit-0 settle is gone.
- A clean empty (no partial content anywhere in the turn) keeps the #1085 M2b semantics exactly: one `continue` nudge per logical turn, then settle.

### Key decisions
- New pure classifier `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` (`lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`) with verdicts `notEmpty` / `emptyAfterPartial` / `cleanEmpty` / `abortedOrError` — shared by the loop's retry machinery and the CLI's nudge gate; the partial-content window is the TURN (messages after the last user message), so an old truncation can never resurrect retries (E1).
- Truncation signals: `StopReason.length` plus the tolerated silent-truncation `errorMessage` flag count as partial-context evidence (E6); the `ToolCall` boundary survives — thinking-only turns with tool calls are never empty (AC6/E4).
- Retry policy lives in the loop (`agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`, a `part of agent_loop.dart` to stay under the 2800-line gate): `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3, knob alongside `maxEmptyRetries`), exponential backoff in the model-roles `retry.baseDelayMs`/`maxBackoffMs` shape (500ms → 8s cap, deterministic), re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`; retried empties stay in the transcript. `CancelToken` is honored between attempts; an abort racing the classification settles `aborted` (exit 130) — never the hiccup error, never a silent empty (E2/E5).
- Exhaustion reuses `StopReason.error` (open question 2) — the existing headless exit-code switch maps it to 1 with no switch change; the legacy `maxEmptyRetries` budget and the CLI's `maxEmptyRetries: 0` wiring are untouched.
- REG-2 scope note: the never-exit-0 contract is enforced for the hiccup family (empty after partial content) across the `stop` / length-flagged / silent-truncation-flagged paths; the clean-empty settle after its one nudge keeps AC2's pinned exit-0 behavior (REG-1).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_empty_completion_hiccup_test.dart
dart test --exclude-tags integration   # full gate suite
```

### Test coverage
- UT-1..UT-5: classifier verdicts incl. thinking+ToolCall not empty, whitespace-only empty, backoff sequence.
- IT-1: `partial → empty → healthy` recovers and finishes (exit 0, retried empty in transcript). IT-2/E3: `partial → empty ×(N+1)` fires exactly N retries then the loud error. IT-3/REG-2: headless exhaustion exits 1 across all stop-reason variants. IT-4/AC5: interactive exhaustion returns to a steerable prompt. REG-1: clean-empty one-nudge tests unchanged.
- UT/IT run in the default CI shard (files verified bin-packed by `shard_files.py`); E2E-1 (live provider lane) and the REG required-check job wiring are CI-config follow-ups, no code dependency.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S[assistant completion] --> C{classifyEmptyCompletion}
  C -->|notEmpty / abortedOrError| OWN[existing terminal paths]
  C -->|cleanEmpty| NUDGE[one continue nudge, then settle - #1085 M2b unchanged]
  C -->|emptyAfterPartial| R[bounded retry: N=3, backoff 500ms to 8s]
  R -->|healthy| RUN[turn continues]
  R -->|cancel| AB[settle aborted - exit 130]
  R -->|N retries spent, still empty| ERR[StopReason.error naming hiccup + attempts + last stop]
  ERR -->|headless -p| X1[exit 1]
  ERR -->|interactive| P[error line + prompt stays alive]
```
</details>

# gh-1577: [GOAL] Empty completion after truncated stream is a retryable hiccup, never a silent exit 0 (B2)

## Description

## Goal — truncated-stream + empty-completion never settles a run as success (v1, initial filing)

One sentence: **an empty assistant completion that follows partial/truncated content becomes a bounded-retry provider hiccup and, on exhaustion, a loud run error — never a silent exit 0** — instead of the one-shot "continue" nudge settling the run as a clean final answer.

Today the CLI treats every empty assistant message alike: `_noteQuietMessageEnd` prints `(empty response: the model returned no text — it may be rate-limited or reasoning-only)` and `_settleAfterPrompt` fires exactly ONE `continue` nudge per logical turn (`_emptyReplyNudgesLeft = 1`, reset in `_beginUserPrompt`). When the second consecutive reply is also empty, the turn settles with `StopReason.stop`, the headless exit-code switch maps it to `0`, and the session dies mid-task. Verified on TB 2.1 artifacts (run 38271607849, `circuit-fibsqrt__{HdcYpf3,jmMMKVo,g2Bt7AT}/agent/fa.txt`): the model's text truncates mid-code (`unsigned long long N = strtoull(argv[1`), the next completion returns empty, the nudge budget is already spent, and the process exits `__FA_EXIT=0` with ~54 minutes left to the session deadline, `gates.txt` unwritten, reward 0 — 3 of 5 trials of one task killed by this path (task score 2/5 instead of a possible 5/5).

## Why this framing

- This is a **run-outcome classification** bug, not a rendering bug: the note text is honest, the exit code is the lie. Earlier adjacent work (#413: exit code from turn events, not transcript; #1085 M2b: one nudge per logical turn) fixed compaction-masking and infinite-loop risks; this card fixes the remaining false-positive class — *truncated stream followed by an empty completion read as an intentional final answer*.
- The fix targets the **agent-loop / settle layer**, not the provider clients: the hiccup signature (partial content earlier in the turn → empty completion now) is visible only where turn history and stop reasons meet.

## Architecture

Named components, all existing:

- **Degenerate-empty classifier** — extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` (`lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`) and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) into a single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts:
  - `emptyAfterPartial` — the turn already contains non-whitespace assistant text or tool activity, OR the previous assistant message carried a truncation signal (`StopReason.length`, or the tolerated-silent-truncation `errorMessage` flag), and the new completion is empty. Verdict: **retryable hiccup**.
  - `cleanEmpty` — no partial content anywhere in the turn, clean `stop`: a genuine empty final. Verdict: existing single-nudge behavior, unchanged.
  - `abortedOrError` — `StopReason.aborted`/`error`: never classified as empty (today's guard, kept).
- **Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial`** — N retries (default 3, config key alongside `maxEmptyRetries`) with exponential backoff (reuse the `retriesPerEntry`/`baseDelayMs`/`maxBackoffMs` shape from `lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`); each retry is re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`; `CancelToken` is honored between attempts (no new request after cancel).
- **Exhaustion verdict** — when retries are spent and the completion is still empty: the run ends with an explicit **run error** (loud error line naming the hiccup, attempt count, and last stop reason), NOT a quiet settle. Headless (`-p`): the terminal stop reason surfaces as `StopReason.error` → exit code 1 (the existing switch at `agent_cli.dart` maps it — extend it if a dedicated stop reason is introduced). Interactive TUI/REPL: the error line plus return to prompt — the user steers; the session is never silently closed.
- Invariants: (1) headless exit 0 requires at least one non-empty assistant message or executed tool call in the run's final turn; (2) a retry never fires after user/harness abort; (3) retried empty messages stay in the transcript (truthful record, as `_retryDegenerateEmpty` already documents); (4) reasoning-only turns (thinking content but no text) WITH tool calls are never classified empty — today's `ToolCall` check in `_assistantMessageIsEmpty` is the boundary and must survive.

## Capability surface

| Surface | Core (this card) | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `emptyAfterPartial` detection | yes | partial = prior text/tool activity in turn OR truncation stop reason/flag on previous message |
| Bounded backoff retry (headless `-p`) | yes | default N=3, configurable; backoff per retry-policy shape |
| Run-error on exhaustion (headless: exit ≠ 0) | yes | exit-code contract: empty-finish never 0 without content |
| Interactive TUI: error + prompt instead of silent settle | yes | same classification, UX is steer/prompt |
| `cleanEmpty` single-nudge | unchanged | issue #1085 M2b semantics preserved |
| Second tier (opt-in follow-up) | — | surface retry events in trajectory view / fa.log structured fields; metric counter for hiccup rate per provider |
| Excluded | provider-client changes | the hiccup is classified at loop level; no HTTP-layer changes — rationale: truncation signature spans messages, invisible to the client |

## Acceptance criteria (testable)

- **AC1** — An empty completion immediately following a turn that produced partial assistant text (or whose previous message ended `StopReason.length` / silent-truncation-flagged) is classified `emptyAfterPartial` and triggers a bounded retry, not the one-shot nudge and not a settle. (UT-1, UT-2, IT-1)
- **AC2** — A clean empty completion with no partial content anywhere in the turn keeps today's behavior exactly: one `continue` nudge per logical turn, then settle. (UT-3, REG-1)
- **AC3** — Retries are bounded (configurable N, default 3) with backoff; each attempt respects cancellation; no retry is issued after an abort. (UT-4, IT-2, E2)
- **AC4** — On retry exhaustion in headless `-p` mode the process exits non-zero with a loud error line; the empty final message can never map to exit 0. (IT-3, REG-2)
- **AC5** — On retry exhaustion in interactive mode the run prints the error and returns to the prompt; the session stays alive and steerable. (IT-4)
- **AC6** — Reasoning-only completions (thinking deltas, no text) that carry tool calls are never classified as empty and never trigger the retry path. (UT-5, E4)
- **AC7** — A model that persistently returns empty (hiccup storm) terminates the run after exactly N retries — no retry storm, no unbounded loop, deterministic attempt count. (IT-2, E3)

## Test plan

### Test matrix — maximal coverage, zero regression on the #1085 settle semantics

- **UT-1** (pure, no IO): `classifyEmptyCompletion` — empty message after partial text in turn → `emptyAfterPartial`. Maps AC1.
- **UT-2**: empty message after previous message with `StopReason.length` and after one with the silent-truncation `errorMessage` flag → `emptyAfterPartial`. Maps AC1.
- **UT-3**: empty message, no prior partial content, clean stop → `cleanEmpty`; budget/budget-exhausted branches of `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` unchanged. Maps AC2.
- **UT-4**: retry policy — attempt count capped at N, backoff sequence computed, `CancelToken` cancelled between attempts suppresses the next attempt. Maps AC3.
- **UT-5**: content classification — thinking-only + `ToolCall` → not empty; thinking-only, no text, no tool calls → empty; whitespace-only text → empty. Maps AC6.
- **IT-1** (fake `StreamFunction` / mock LLM, deterministic): scripted sequence `partial text stream → empty completion → healthy completion` — the agent retries and finishes the task; assert the run's final exit outcome is success and the retried empties are in the transcript. Maps AC1, AC3.
- **IT-2**: scripted `partial → empty × (N+1)` — exactly N retries fire (no storm), then exhaustion verdict. Maps AC3, AC7, E3.
- **IT-3**: headless `-p` run driven to exhaustion — process exit code is non-zero, stderr carries the error line naming attempts and last stop reason. Maps AC4, REG-2.

- This is a **run-outcome classification** bug, not a rendering bug: the note text is honest, the exit code is the lie. Earlier adjacent work (#413: exit code from turn events, not transcript; #1085 M2b: one nudge per logical turn) fixed compaction-masking and infinite-loop risks; this card fixes the remaining false-positive class — *truncated stream followed by an empty completion read as an intentional final answer*.
- The fix targets the **agent-loop / settle layer**, not the provider clients: the hiccup signature (partial content earlier in the turn → empty completion now) is visible only where turn history and stop reasons meet.

- **Degenerate-empty classifier** — extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` (`lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`) and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) into a single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts:

Verdict: **retryable hiccup**.
  - `cleanEmpty` — no partial content anywhere in the turn, clean `stop`: a genuine empty final. Verdict: existing single-nudge behavior, unchanged.

- **Exhaustion verdict** — when retries are spent and the completion is still empty: the run ends with an explicit **run error** (loud error line naming the hiccup, attempt count, and last stop reason), NOT a quiet settle. Headless (`-p`): the terminal stop reason surfaces as `StopReason.error` → exit code 1 (the existing switch at `agent_cli.dart` maps it — extend it if a dedicated stop reason is introduced). Interactive TUI/REPL: the error line plus return to prompt — the user steers; the session is never silently closed.

## PR Description

Closes #1577
## gh-1577 — Empty completion after truncated stream is a retryable hiccup, never a silent exit 0

### What changed
- An empty assistant completion that follows partial content (assistant text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is now a **bounded-retry provider hiccup** in the agent loop; on retry exhaustion the run ends with a loud `StopReason.error` naming the hiccup, attempt count and last stop reason — headless `-p` exits 1, interactive prints the error and returns to the prompt. The silent exit-0 settle is gone.
- A clean empty (no partial content anywhere in the turn) keeps the #1085 M2b semantics exactly: one `continue` nudge per logical turn, then settle.

### Key decisions
- New pure classifier `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` (`lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`) with verdicts `notEmpty` / `emptyAfterPartial` / `cleanEmpty` / `abortedOrError` — shared by the loop's retry machinery and the CLI's nudge gate; the partial-content window is the TURN (messages after the last user message), so an old truncation can never resurrect retries (E1).
- Truncation signals: `StopReason.length` plus the tolerated silent-truncation `errorMessage` flag count as partial-context evidence (E6); the `ToolCall` boundary survives — thinking-only turns with tool calls are never empty (AC6/E4).
- Retry policy lives in the loop (`agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`, a `part of agent_loop.dart` to stay under the 2800-line gate): `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3, knob alongside `maxEmptyRetries`), exponential backoff in the model-roles `retry.baseDelayMs`/`maxBackoffMs` shape (500ms → 8s cap, deterministic), re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`; retried empties stay in the transcript. `CancelToken` is honored between attempts; an abort racing the classification settles `aborted` (exit 130) — never the hiccup error, never a silent empty (E2/E5).
- Exhaustion reuses `StopReason.error` (open question 2) — the existing headless exit-code switch maps it to 1 with no switch change; the legacy `maxEmptyRetries` budget and the CLI's `maxEmptyRetries: 0` wiring are untouched.
- REG-2 scope note: the never-exit-0 contract is enforced for the hiccup family (empty after partial content) across the `stop` / length-flagged / silent-truncation-flagged paths; the clean-empty settle after its one nudge keeps AC2's pinned exit-0 behavior (REG-1).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_empty_completion_hiccup_test.dart
dart test --exclude-tags integration   # full gate suite
```

### Test coverage
- UT-1..UT-5: classifier verdicts incl. thinking+ToolCall not empty, whitespace-only empty, backoff sequence.
- IT-1: `partial → empty → healthy` recovers and finishes (exit 0, retried empty in transcript). IT-2/E3: `partial → empty ×(N+1)` fires exactly N retries then the loud error. IT-3/REG-2: headless exhaustion exits 1 across all stop-reason variants. IT-4/AC5: interactive exhaustion returns to a steerable prompt. REG-1: clean-empty one-nudge tests unchanged.
- UT/IT run in the default CI shard (files verified bin-packed by `shard_files.py`); E2E-1 (live provider lane) and the REG required-check job wiring are CI-config follow-ups, no code dependency.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S[assistant completion] --> C{classifyEmptyCompletion}
  C -->|notEmpty / abortedOrError| OWN[existing terminal paths]
  C -->|cleanEmpty| NUDGE[one continue nudge, then settle - #1085 M2b unchanged]
  C -->|emptyAfterPartial| R[bounded retry: N=3, backoff 500ms to 8s]
  R -->|healthy| RUN[turn continues]
  R -->|cancel| AB[settle aborted - exit 130]
  R -->|N retries spent, still empty| ERR[StopReason.error naming hiccup + attempts + last stop]
  ERR -->|headless -p| X1[exit 1]
  ERR -->|interactive| P[error line + prompt stays alive]
```
</details>

# gh-1577: [GOAL] Empty completion after truncated stream is a retryable hiccup, never a silent exit 0 (B2)

## Description

## Goal — truncated-stream + empty-completion never settles a run as success (v1, initial filing)

One sentence: **an empty assistant completion that follows partial/truncated content becomes a bounded-retry provider hiccup and, on exhaustion, a loud run error — never a silent exit 0** — instead of the one-shot "continue" nudge settling the run as a clean final answer.

Today the CLI treats every empty assistant message alike: `_noteQuietMessageEnd` prints `(empty response: the model returned no text — it may be rate-limited or reasoning-only)` and `_settleAfterPrompt` fires exactly ONE `continue` nudge per logical turn (`_emptyReplyNudgesLeft = 1`, reset in `_beginUserPrompt`). When the second consecutive reply is also empty, the turn settles with `StopReason.stop`, the headless exit-code switch maps it to `0`, and the session dies mid-task. Verified on TB 2.1 artifacts (run 38271607849, `circuit-fibsqrt__{HdcYpf3,jmMMKVo,g2Bt7AT}/agent/fa.txt`): the model's text truncates mid-code (`unsigned long long N = strtoull(argv[1`), the next completion returns empty, the nudge budget is already spent, and the process exits `__FA_EXIT=0` with ~54 minutes left to the session deadline, `gates.txt` unwritten, reward 0 — 3 of 5 trials of one task killed by this path (task score 2/5 instead of a possible 5/5).

## Why this framing

- This is a **run-outcome classification** bug, not a rendering bug: the note text is honest, the exit code is the lie. Earlier adjacent work (#413: exit code from turn events, not transcript; #1085 M2b: one nudge per logical turn) fixed compaction-masking and infinite-loop risks; this card fixes the remaining false-positive class — *truncated stream followed by an empty completion read as an intentional final answer*.
- The fix targets the **agent-loop / settle layer**, not the provider clients: the hiccup signature (partial content earlier in the turn → empty completion now) is visible only where turn history and stop reasons meet.

## Architecture

Named components, all existing:

- **Degenerate-empty classifier** — extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` (`lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`) and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) into a single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts:
  - `emptyAfterPartial` — the turn already contains non-whitespace assistant text or tool activity, OR the previous assistant message carried a truncation signal (`StopReason.length`, or the tolerated-silent-truncation `errorMessage` flag), and the new completion is empty. Verdict: **retryable hiccup**.
  - `cleanEmpty` — no partial content anywhere in the turn, clean `stop`: a genuine empty final. Verdict: existing single-nudge behavior, unchanged.
  - `abortedOrError` — `StopReason.aborted`/`error`: never classified as empty (today's guard, kept).
- **Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial`** — N retries (default 3, config key alongside `maxEmptyRetries`) with exponential backoff (reuse the `retriesPerEntry`/`baseDelayMs`/`maxBackoffMs` shape from `lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`); each retry is re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`; `CancelToken` is honored between attempts (no new request after cancel).
- **Exhaustion verdict** — when retries are spent and the completion is still empty: the run ends with an explicit **run error** (loud error line naming the hiccup, attempt count, and last stop reason), NOT a quiet settle. Headless (`-p`): the terminal stop reason surfaces as `StopReason.error` → exit code 1 (the existing switch at `agent_cli.dart` maps it — extend it if a dedicated stop reason is introduced). Interactive TUI/REPL: the error line plus return to prompt — the user steers; the session is never silently closed.
- Invariants: (1) headless exit 0 requires at least one non-empty assistant message or executed tool call in the run's final turn; (2) a retry never fires after user/harness abort; (3) retried empty messages stay in the transcript (truthful record, as `_retryDegenerateEmpty` already documents); (4) reasoning-only turns (thinking content but no text) WITH tool calls are never classified empty — today's `ToolCall` check in `_assistantMessageIsEmpty` is the boundary and must survive.

## Capability surface

| Surface | Core (this card) | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `emptyAfterPartial` detection | yes | partial = prior text/tool activity in turn OR truncation stop reason/flag on previous message |
| Bounded backoff retry (headless `-p`) | yes | default N=3, configurable; backoff per retry-policy shape |
| Run-error on exhaustion (headless: exit ≠ 0) | yes | exit-code contract: empty-finish never 0 without content |
| Interactive TUI: error + prompt instead of silent settle | yes | same classification, UX is steer/prompt |
| `cleanEmpty` single-nudge | unchanged | issue #1085 M2b semantics preserved |
| Second tier (opt-in follow-up) | — | surface retry events in trajectory view / fa.log structured fields; metric counter for hiccup rate per provider |
| Excluded | provider-client changes | the hiccup is classified at loop level; no HTTP-layer changes — rationale: truncation signature spans messages, invisible to the client |

## Acceptance criteria (testable)

- **AC1** — An empty completion immediately following a turn that produced partial assistant text (or whose previous message ended `StopReason.length` / silent-truncation-flagged) is classified `emptyAfterPartial` and triggers a bounded retry, not the one-shot nudge and not a settle. (UT-1, UT-2, IT-1)
- **AC2** — A clean empty completion with no partial content anywhere in the turn keeps today's behavior exactly: one `continue` nudge per logical turn, then settle. (UT-3, REG-1)
- **AC3** — Retries are bounded (configurable N, default 3) with backoff; each attempt respects cancellation; no retry is issued after an abort. (UT-4, IT-2, E2)
- **AC4** — On retry exhaustion in headless `-p` mode the process exits non-zero with a loud error line; the empty final message can never map to exit 0. (IT-3, REG-2)
- **AC5** — On retry exhaustion in interactive mode the run prints the error and returns to the prompt; the session stays alive and steerable. (IT-4)
- **AC6** — Reasoning-only completions (thinking deltas, no text) that carry tool calls are never classified as empty and never trigger the retry path. (UT-5, E4)
- **AC7** — A model that persistently returns empty (hiccup storm) terminates the run after exactly N retries — no retry storm, no unbounded loop, deterministic attempt count. (IT-2, E3)

## Test plan

### Test matrix — maximal coverage, zero regression on the #1085 settle semantics

- **UT-1** (pure, no IO): `classifyEmptyCompletion` — empty message after partial text in turn → `emptyAfterPartial`. Maps AC1.
- **UT-2**: empty message after previous message with `StopReason.length` and after one with the silent-truncation `errorMessage` flag → `emptyAfterPartial`. Maps AC1.
- **UT-3**: empty message, no prior partial content, clean stop → `cleanEmpty`; budget/budget-exhausted branches of `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` unchanged. Maps AC2.
- **UT-4**: retry policy — attempt count capped at N, backoff sequence computed, `CancelToken` cancelled between attempts suppresses the next attempt. Maps AC3.
- **UT-5**: content classification — thinking-only + `ToolCall` → not empty; thinking-only, no text, no tool calls → empty; whitespace-only text → empty. Maps AC6.
- **IT-1** (fake `StreamFunction` / mock LLM, deterministic): scripted sequence `partial text stream → empty completion → healthy completion` — the agent retries and finishes the task; assert the run's final exit outcome is success and the retried empties are in the transcript. Maps AC1, AC3.
- **IT-2**: scripted `partial → empty × (N+1)` — exactly N retries fire (no storm), then exhaustion verdict. Maps AC3, AC7, E3.
- **IT-3**: headless `-p` run driven to exhaustion — process exit code is non-zero, stderr carries the error line naming attempts and last stop reason. Maps AC4, REG-2.

Verified on TB 2.1 artifacts (run 38271607849, `circuit-fibsqrt__{HdcYpf3,jmMMKVo,g2Bt7AT}/agent/fa.txt`): the model's text truncates mid-code (`unsigned long long N = strtoull(argv[1`), the next completion returns empty, the nudge budget is already spent, and the process exits `__FA_EXIT=0` with ~54 minutes left to the session deadline, `gates.txt` unwritten, reward 0 — 3 of 5 trials of one task killed by this path (task score 2/5 instead of a possible 5/5).

## Why this framing

- This is a **run-outcome classification** bug, not a rendering bug: the note text is honest, the exit code is the lie. Earlier adjacent work (#413: exit code from turn events, not transcript; #1085 M2b: one nudge per logical turn) fixed compaction-masking and infinite-loop risks; this card fixes the remaining false-positive class — *truncated stream followed by an empty completion read as an intentional final answer*.
- The fix targets the **agent-loop / settle layer**, not the provider clients: the hiccup signature (partial content earlier in the turn → empty completion now) is visible only where turn history and stop reasons meet.

## Architecture

Named components, all existing:

- **Degenerate-empty classifier** — extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` (`lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`) and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) into a single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts:
  - `emptyAfterPartial` — the turn already contains non-whitespace assistant text or tool activity, OR the previous assistant message carried a truncation signal (`StopReason.length`, or the tolerated-silent-truncation `errorMessage` flag), and the new completion is empty. Verdict: **retryable hiccup**.
  - `cleanEmpty` — no partial content anywhere in the turn, clean `stop`: a genuine empty final. Verdict: existing single-nudge behavior, unchanged.
  - `abortedOrError` — `StopReason.aborted`/`error`: never classified as empty (today's guard, kept).
- **Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial`** — N retries (default 3, config key alongside `maxEmptyRetries`) with exponential backoff (reuse the `retriesPerEntry`/`baseDelayMs`/`maxBackoffMs` shape from `lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`); each retry is re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`; `CancelToken` is honored between attempts (no new request after cancel).
- **Exhaustion verdict** — when retries are spent and the completion is still empty: the run ends with an explicit **run error** (loud error line naming the hiccup, attempt count, and last stop reason), NOT a quiet settle. Headless (`-p`): the terminal stop reason surfaces as `StopReason.error` → exit code 1 (the existing switch at `agent_cli.dart` maps it — extend it if a dedicated stop reason is introduced). Interactive TUI/REPL: the error line plus return to prompt — the user steers; the session is never silently closed.
- Invariants: (1) headless exit 0 requires at least one non-empty assistant message or executed tool call in the run's final turn; (2) a retry never fires after user/harness abort; (3) retried empty messages stay in the transcript (truthful record, as `_retryDegenerateEmpty` already documents); (4) reasoning-only turns (thinking content but no text) WITH tool calls are never classified empty — today's `ToolCall` check in `_assistantMessageIsEmpty` is the boundary and must survive.

## Capability surface

|---|---|---|
| `emptyAfterPartial` detection | yes | partial = prior text/tool activity in turn OR truncation stop reason/flag on previous message |
| Bounded backoff retry (headless `-p`) | yes | default N=3, configurable; backoff per retry-policy shape |
| Run-error on exhaustion (headless: exit ≠ 0) | yes | exit-code contract: empty-finish never 0 without content |
| Interactive TUI: error + prompt instead of silent settle | yes | same classification, UX is steer/prompt |
| `cleanEmpty` single-nudge | unchanged | issue #1085 M2b semantics preserved |
| Second tier (opt-in follow-up) | — | surface retry events in trajectory view / fa.log structured fields; metric counter for hiccup rate per provider |
| Excluded | provider-client changes | the hiccup is classified at loop level; no HTTP-layer changes — rationale: truncation signature spans messages, invisible to the client |

## Acceptance criteria (testable)

- **AC1** — An empty completion immediately following a turn that produced partial assistant text (or whose previous message ended `StopReason.length` / silent-truncation-flagged) is classified `emptyAfterPartial` and triggers a bounded retry, not the one-shot nudge and not a settle. (UT-1, UT-2, IT-1)
- **AC2** — A clean empty completion with no partial content anywhere in the turn keeps today's behavior exactly: one `continue` nudge per logical turn, then settle. (UT-3, REG-1)
- **AC3** — Retries are bounded (configurable N, default 3) with backoff; each attempt respects cancellation; no retry is issued after an abort. (UT-4, IT-2, E2)
- **AC4** — On retry exhaustion in headless `-p` mode the process exits non-zero with a loud error line; the empty final message can never map to exit 0. (IT-3, REG-2)
- **AC5** — On retry exhaustion in interactive mode the run prints the error and returns to the prompt; the session stays alive and steerable. (IT-4)
- **AC6** — Reasoning-only completions (thinking deltas, no text) that carry tool calls are never classified as empty and never trigger the retry path. (UT-5, E4)
- **AC7** — A model that persistently returns empty (hiccup storm) terminates the run after exactly N retries — no retry storm, no unbounded loop, deterministic attempt count. (IT-2, E3)

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 10
- **Additions**: +983
- **Deletions**: -40

- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T10:44:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1577
## gh-1577 — Empty completion after truncated stream is a retryable hiccup, never a silent exit 0

### What changed
- An empty assistant completion that follows partial content (assistant text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is now a **bounded-retry provider hiccup** in the agent loop; on retry exhaustion the run ends with a loud `StopReason.error` naming the hiccup, attempt count and last stop reason — headless `-p` exits 1, interactive prints the error and returns to the prompt. The silent exit-0 settle is gone.
- A clean empty (no partial content anywhere in the turn) keeps the #1085 M2b semantics exactly: one `continue` nudge per logical turn, then settle.

### Key decisions
- New pure classifier `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` (`lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`) with verdicts `notEmpty` / `emptyAfterPartial` / `cleanEmpty` / `abortedOrError` — shared by the loop's retry machinery and the CLI's nudge gate; the partial-content window is the TURN (messages after the last user message), so an old truncation can never resurrect retries (E1).
- Truncation signals: `StopReason.length` plus the tolerated silent-truncation `errorMessage` flag count as partial-context evidence (E6); the `ToolCall` boundary survives — thinking-only turns with tool calls are never empty (AC6/E4).
- Retry policy lives in the loop (`agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`, a `part of agent_loop.dart` to stay under the 2800-line gate): `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3, knob alongside `maxEmptyRetries`), exponential backoff in the model-roles `retry.baseDelayMs`/`maxBackoffMs` shape (500ms → 8s cap, deterministic), re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`; retried empties stay in the transcript. `CancelToken` is honored between attempts; an abort racing the classification settles `aborted` (exit 130) — never the hiccup error, never a silent empty (E2/E5).
- Exhaustion reuses `StopReason.error` (open question 2) — the existing headless exit-code switch maps it to 1 with no switch change; the legacy `maxEmptyRetries` budget and the CLI's `maxEmptyRetries: 0` wiring are untouched.
- REG-2 scope note: the never-exit-0 contract is enforced for the hiccup family (empty after partial content) across the `stop` / length-flagged / silent-truncation-flagged paths; the clean-empty settle after its one nudge keeps AC2's pinned exit-0 behavior (REG-1).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_empty_completion_hiccup_test.dart
dart test --exclude-tags integration   # full gate suite
```

### Test coverage
- UT-1..UT-5: classifier verdicts incl. thinking+ToolCall not empty, whitespace-only empty, backoff sequence.
- IT-1: `partial → empty → healthy` recovers and finishes (exit 0, retried empty in transcript). IT-2/E3: `partial → empty ×(N+1)` fires exactly N retries then the loud error. IT-3/REG-2: headless exhaustion exits 1 across all stop-reason variants. IT-4/AC5: interactive exhaustion returns to a steerable prompt. REG-1: clean-empty one-nudge tests unchanged.
- UT/IT run in the default CI shard (files verified bin-packed by `shard_files.py`); E2E-1 (live provider lane) and the REG required-check job wiring are CI-config follow-ups, no code dependency.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S[assistant completion] --> C{classifyEmptyCompletion}
  C -->|notEmpty / abortedOrError| OWN[existing terminal paths]
  C -->|cleanEmpty| NUDGE[one continue nudge, then settle - #1085 M2b unchanged]
  C -->|emptyAfterPartial| R[bounded retry: N=3, backoff 500ms to 8s]
  R -->|healthy| RUN[turn continues]
  R -->|cancel| AB[settle aborted - exit 130]
  R -->|N retries spent, still empty| ERR[StopReason.error naming hiccup + attempts + last stop]
  ERR -->|headless -p| X1[exit 1]
  ERR -->|interactive| P[error line + prompt stays alive]
```
</details>

# gh-1577: [GOAL] Empty completion after truncated stream is a retryable hiccup, never a silent exit 0 (B2)

## Description

## Goal — truncated-stream + empty-completion never settles a run as success (v1, initial filing)

One sentence: **an empty assistant completion that follows partial/truncated content becomes a bounded-retry provider hiccup and, on exhaustion, a loud run error — never a silent exit 0** — instead of the one-shot "continue" nudge settling the run as a clean final answer.

Today the CLI treats every empty assistant message alike: `_noteQuietMessageEnd` prints `(empty response: the model returned no text — it may be rate-limited or reasoning-only)` and `_settleAfterPrompt` fires exactly ONE `continue` nudge per logical turn (`_emptyReplyNudgesLeft = 1`, reset in `_beginUserPrompt`). When the second consecutive reply is also empty, the turn settles with `StopReason.stop`, the headless exit-code switch maps it to `0`, and the session dies mid-task. Verified on TB 2.1 artifacts (run 38271607849, `circuit-fibsqrt__{HdcYpf3,jmMMKVo,g2Bt7AT}/agent/fa.txt`): the model's text truncates mid-code (`unsigned long long N = strtoull(argv[1`), the next completion returns empty, the nudge budget is already spent, and the process exits `__FA_EXIT=0` with ~54 minutes left to the session deadline, `gates.txt` unwritten, reward 0 — 3 of 5 trials of one task killed by this path (task score 2/5 instead of a possible 5/5).

## Why this framing

- This is a **run-outcome classification** bug, not a rendering bug: the note text is honest, the exit code is the lie. Earlier adjacent work (#413: exit code from turn events, not transcript; #1085 M2b: one nudge per logical turn) fixed compaction-masking and infinite-loop risks; this card fixes the remaining false-positive class — *truncated stream followed by an empty completion read as an intentional final answer*.
- The fix targets the **agent-loop / settle layer**, not the provider clients: the hiccup signature (partial content earlier in the turn → empty completion now) is visible only where turn history and stop reasons meet.

## Architecture

Named components, all existing:

- **Degenerate-empty classifier** — extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` (`lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`) and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) into a single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts:
  - `emptyAfterPartial` — the turn already contains non-whitespace assistant text or tool activity, OR the previous assistant message carried a truncation signal (`StopReason.length`, or the tolerated-silent-truncation `errorMessage` flag), and the new completion is empty. Verdict: **retryable hiccup**.
  - `cleanEmpty` — no partial content anywhere in the turn, clean `stop`: a genuine empty final. Verdict: existing single-nudge behavior, unchanged.
  - `abortedOrError` — `StopReason.aborted`/`error`: never classified as empty (today's guard, kept).
- **Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial`** — N retries (default 3, config key alongside `maxEmptyRetries`) with exponential backoff (reuse the `retriesPerEntry`/`baseDelayMs`/`maxBackoffMs` shape from `lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`); each retry is re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`; `CancelToken` is honored between attempts (no new request after cancel).
- **Exhaustion verdict** — when retries are spent and the completion is still empty: the run ends with an explicit **run error** (loud error line naming the hiccup, attempt count, and last stop reason), NOT a quiet settle. Headless (`-p`): the terminal stop reason surfaces as `StopReason.error` → exit code 1 (the existing switch at `agent_cli.dart` maps it — extend it if a dedicated stop reason is introduced). Interactive TUI/REPL: the error line plus return to prompt — the user steers; the session is never silently closed.
- Invariants: (1) headless exit 0 requires at least one non-empty assistant message or executed tool call in the run's final turn; (2) a retry never fires after user/harness abort; (3) retried empty messages stay in the transcript (truthful record, as `_retryDegenerateEmpty` already documents); (4) reasoning-only turns (thinking content but no text) WITH tool calls are never classified empty — today's `ToolCall` check in `_assistantMessageIsEmpty` is the boundary and must survive.

## Capability surface

| Surface | Core (this card) | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `emptyAfterPartial` detection | yes | partial = prior text/tool activity in turn OR truncation stop reason/flag on previous message |
| Bounded backoff retry (headless `-p`) | yes | default N=3, configurable; backoff per retry-policy shape |
| Run-error on exhaustion (headless: exit ≠ 0) | yes | exit-code contract: empty-finish never 0 without content |
| Interactive TUI: error + prompt instead of silent settle | yes | same classification, UX is steer/prompt |
| `cleanEmpty` single-nudge | unchanged | issue #1085 M2b semantics preserved |
| Second tier (opt-in follow-up) | — | surface retry events in trajectory view / fa.log structured fields; metric counter for hiccup rate per provider |

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1577` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 10
- **Additions**: +983
- **Deletions**: -40
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:03:44Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T10:44:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1577
## gh-1577 — Empty completion after truncated stream is a retryable hiccup, never a silent exit 0

### What changed
- An empty assistant completion that follows partial content (assistant text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is now a **bounded-retry provider hiccup** in the agent loop; on retry exhaustion the run ends with a loud `StopReason.error` naming the hiccup, attempt count and last stop reason — headless `-p` exits 1, interactive prints the error and returns to the prompt. The silent exit-0 settle is gone.
- A clean empty (no partial content anywhere in the turn) keeps the #1085 M2b semantics exactly: one `continue` nudge per logical turn, then settle.

### Key decisions
- New pure classifier `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` (`lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`) with verdicts `notEmpty` / `emptyAfterPartial` / `cleanEmpty` / `abortedOrError` — shared by the loop's retry machinery and the CLI's nudge gate; the partial-content window is the TURN (messages after the last user message), so an old truncation can never resurrect retries (E1).
- Truncation signals: `StopReason.length` plus the tolerated silent-truncation `errorMessage` flag count as partial-context evidence (E6); the `ToolCall` boundary survives — thinking-only turns with tool calls are never empty (AC6/E4).
- Retry policy lives in the loop (`agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`, a `part of agent_loop.dart` to stay under the 2800-line gate): `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3, knob alongside `maxEmptyRetries`), exponential backoff in the model-roles `retry.baseDelayMs`/`maxBackoffMs` shape (500ms → 8s cap, deterministic), re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`; retried empties stay in the transcript. `CancelToken` is honored between attempts; an abort racing the classification settles `aborted` (exit 130) — never the hiccup error, never a silent empty (E2/E5).
- Exhaustion reuses `StopReason.error` (open question 2) — the existing headless exit-code switch maps it to 1 with no switch change; the legacy `maxEmptyRetries` budget and the CLI's `maxEmptyRetries: 0` wiring are untouched.
- REG-2 scope note: the never-exit-0 contract is enforced for the hiccup family (empty after partial content) across the `stop` / length-flagged / silent-truncation-flagged paths; the clean-empty settle after its one nudge keeps AC2's pinned exit-0 behavior (REG-1).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_empty_completion_hiccup_test.dart
dart test --exclude-tags integration   # full gate suite
```

### Test coverage
- UT-1..UT-5: classifier verdicts incl. thinking+ToolCall not empty, whitespace-only empty, backoff sequence.
- IT-1: `partial → empty → healthy` recovers and finishes (exit 0, retried empty in transcript). IT-2/E3: `partial → empty ×(N+1)` fires exactly N retries then the loud error. IT-3/REG-2: headless exhaustion exits 1 across all stop-reason variants. IT-4/AC5: interactive exhaustion returns to a steerable prompt. REG-1: clean-empty one-nudge tests unchanged.
- UT/IT run in the default CI shard (files verified bin-packed by `shard_files.py`); E2E-1 (live provider lane) and the REG required-check job wiring are CI-config follow-ups, no code dependency.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S[assistant completion] --> C{classifyEmptyCompletion}
  C -->|notEmpty / abortedOrError| OWN[existing terminal paths]
  C -->|cleanEmpty| NUDGE[one continue nudge, then settle - #1085 M2b unchanged]
  C -->|emptyAfterPartial| R[bounded retry: N=3, backoff 500ms to 8s]
  R -->|healthy| RUN[turn continues]
  R -->|cancel| AB[settle aborted - exit 130]
  R -->|N retries spent, still empty| ERR[StopReason.error naming hiccup + attempts + last stop]
  ERR -->|headless -p| X1[exit 1]
  ERR -->|interactive| P[error line + prompt stays alive]
```
</details>

# gh-1577: [GOAL] Empty completion after truncated stream is a retryable hiccup, never a silent exit 0 (B2)

## Description

## Goal — truncated-stream + empty-completion never settles a run as success (v1, initial filing)

One sentence: **an empty assistant completion that follows partial/truncated content becomes a bounded-retry provider hiccup and, on exhaustion, a loud run error — never a silent exit 0** — instead of the one-shot "continue" nudge settling the run as a clean final answer.

Today the CLI treats every empty assistant message alike: `_noteQuietMessageEnd` prints `(empty response: the model returned no text — it may be rate-limited or reasoning-only)` and `_settleAfterPrompt` fires exactly ONE `continue` nudge per logical turn (`_emptyReplyNudgesLeft = 1`, reset in `_beginUserPrompt`). When the second consecutive reply is also empty, the turn settles with `StopReason.stop`, the headless exit-code switch maps it to `0`, and the session dies mid-task. ## PR Description

Closes #1577
## gh-1577 — Empty completion after truncated stream is a retryable hiccup, never a silent exit 0

### What changed
- An empty assistant completion that follows partial content (assistant text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is now a **bounded-retry provider hiccup** in the agent loop; on retry exhaustion the run ends with a loud `StopReason.error` naming the hiccup, attempt count and last stop reason — headless `-p` exits 1, interactive prints the error and returns to the prompt. The silent exit-0 settle is gone.
- A clean empty (no partial content anywhere in the turn) keeps the #1085 M2b semantics exactly: one `continue` nudge per logical turn, then settle.

### Key decisions
- New pure classifier `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` (`lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`) with verdicts `notEmpty` / `emptyAfterPartial` / `cleanEmpty` / `abortedOrError` — shared by the loop's retry machinery and the CLI's nudge gate; the partial-content window is the TURN (messages after the last user message), so an old truncation can never resurrect retries (E1).
- Truncation signals: `StopReason.length` plus the tolerated silent-truncation `errorMessage` flag count as partial-context evidence (E6); the `ToolCall` boundary survives — thinking-only turns with tool calls are never empty (AC6/E4).

# gh-1577: [GOAL] Empty completion after truncated stream is a retryable hiccup, never a silent exit 0 (B2)

## Description

## Goal — truncated-stream + empty-completion never settles a run as success (v1, initial filing)

One sentence: **an empty assistant completion that follows partial/truncated content becomes a bounded-retry provider hiccup and, on exhaustion, a loud run error — never a silent exit 0** — instead of the one-shot "continue" nudge settling the run as a clean final answer.

Today the CLI treats every empty assistant message alike: `_noteQuietMessageEnd` prints `(empty response: the model returned no text — it may be rate-limited or reasoning-only)` and `_settleAfterPrompt` fires exactly ONE `continue` nudge per logical turn (`_emptyReplyNudgesLeft = 1`, reset in `_beginUserPrompt`). When the second consecutive reply is also empty, the turn settles with `StopReason.stop`, the headless exit-code switch maps it to `0`, and the session dies mid-task. Verified on TB 2.1 artifacts (run 38271607849, `circuit-fibsqrt__{HdcYpf3,jmMMKVo,g2Bt7AT}/agent/fa.txt`): the model's text truncates mid-code (`unsigned long long N = strtoull(argv[1`), the next completion returns empty, the nudge budget is already spent, and the process exits `__FA_EXIT=0` with ~54 minutes left to the session deadline, `gates.txt` unwritten, reward 0 — 3 of 5 trials of one task killed by this path (task score 2/5 instead of a possible 5/5).

## Why this framing

- This is a **run-outcome classification** bug, not a rendering bug: the note text is honest, the exit code is the lie. Earlier adjacent work (#413: exit code from turn events, not transcript; #1085 M2b: one nudge per logical turn) fixed compaction-masking and infinite-loop risks; this card fixes the remaining false-positive class — *truncated stream followed by an empty completion read as an intentional final answer*.
- The fix targets the **agent-loop / settle layer**, not the provider clients: the hiccup signature (partial content earlier in the turn → empty completion now) is visible only where turn history and stop reasons meet.

## Architecture

Named components, all existing:

- **Degenerate-empty classifier** — extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` (`lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`) and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) into a single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts:
  - `emptyAfterPartial` — the turn already contains non-whitespace assistant text or tool activity, OR the previous assistant message carried a truncation signal (`StopReason.length`, or the tolerated-silent-truncation `errorMessage` flag), and the new completion is empty. Verdict: **retryable hiccup**.
  - `cleanEmpty` — no partial content anywhere in the turn, clean `stop`: a genuine empty final. Verdict: existing single-nudge behavior, unchanged.
  - `abortedOrError` — `StopReason.aborted`/`error`: never classified as empty (today's guard, kept).
- **Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial`** — N retries (default 3, config key alongside `maxEmptyRetries`) with exponential backoff (reuse the `retriesPerEntry`/`baseDelayMs`/`maxBackoffMs` shape from `lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`); each retry is re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`; `CancelToken` is honored between attempts (no new request after cancel).
- **Exhaustion verdict** — when retries are spent and the completion is still empty: the run ends with an explicit **run error** (loud error line naming the hiccup, attempt count, and last stop reason), NOT a quiet settle. Headless (`-p`): the terminal stop reason surfaces as `StopReason.error` → exit code 1 (the existing switch at `agent_cli.dart` maps it — extend it if a dedicated stop reason is introduced). Interactive TUI/REPL: the error line plus return to prompt — the user steers; the session is never silently closed.
- Invariants: (1) headless exit 0 requires at least one non-empty assistant message or executed tool call in the run's final turn; (2) a retry never fires after user/harness abort; (3) retried empty messages stay in the transcript (truthful record, as `_retryDegenerateEmpty` already documents); (4) reasoning-only turns (thinking content but no text) WITH tool calls are never classified empty — today's `ToolCall` check in `_assistantMessageIsEmpty` is the boundary and must survive.

## Capability surface

| Surface | Core (this card) | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `emptyAfterPartial` detection | yes | partial = prior text/tool activity in turn OR truncation stop reason/flag on previous message |
| Bounded backoff retry (headless `-p`) | yes | default N=3, configurable; backoff per retry-policy shape |
| Run-error on exhaustion (headless: exit ≠ 0) | yes | exit-code contract: empty-finish never 0 without content |
| Interactive TUI: error + prompt instead of silent settle | yes | same classification, UX is steer/prompt |
| `cleanEmpty` single-nudge | unchanged | issue #1085 M2b semantics preserved |
| Second tier (opt-in follow-up) | — | surface retry events in trajectory view / fa.log structured fields; metric counter for hiccup rate per provider |
| Excluded | provider-client changes | the hiccup is classified at loop level; no HTTP-layer changes — rationale: truncation signature spans messages, invisible to the client |

## Acceptance criteria (testable)

- **AC1** — An empty completion immediately following a turn that produced partial assistant text (or whose previous message ended `StopReason.length` / silent-truncation-flagged) is classified `emptyAfterPartial` and triggers a bounded retry, not the one-shot nudge and not a settle. - **AC2** — A clean empty completion with no partial content anywhere in the turn keeps today's behavior exactly: one `continue` nudge per logical turn, then settle. (UT-3, REG-1)
- **AC3** — Retries are bounded (configurable N, default 3) with backoff; each attempt respects cancellation; no retry is issued after an abort. (UT-4, IT-2, E2)
- **AC4** — On retry exhaustion in headless `-p` mode the process exits non-zero with a loud error line; the empty final message can never map to exit 0. (IT-3, REG-2)
- **AC5** — On retry exhaustion in interactive mode the run prints the error and returns to the prompt; the session stays alive and steerable. (IT-4)
- **AC6** — Reasoning-only completions (thinking deltas, no text) that carry tool calls are never classified as empty and never trigger the retry path. (UT-5, E4)
- **AC7** — A model that persistently returns empty (hiccup storm) terminates the run after exactly N retries — no retry storm, no unbounded loop, deterministic attempt count. (IT-2, E3)

- **UT-2**: empty message after previous message with `StopReason.length` and after one with the silent-truncation `errorMessage` flag → `emptyAfterPartial`. Maps AC1.

- **IT-1** (fake `StreamFunction` / mock LLM, deterministic): scripted sequence `partial text stream → empty completion → healthy completion` — the agent retries and finishes the task; assert the run's final exit outcome is success and the retried empties are in the transcript. Maps AC1, AC3.
- **IT-2**: scripted `partial → empty × (N+1)` — exactly N retries fire (no storm), then exhaustion verdict. Maps AC3, AC7, E3.
- **IT-3**: headless `-p` run driven to exhaustion — process exit code is non-zero, stderr carries the error line naming attempts and last stop reason. Maps AC4, REG-2.

Senior Code Reviewer & Security Expert You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,
pr_diff.txt, pr_files.txt, ci_failures.md,

pr_discussions_raw.json"] READ --> DIFF["2. Run diff checklist on pr_diff.txt"] DIFF --> FILES["3. Read full content of every changed file"] FILES --> CODEGRAPH["4. Use CodeGraph:
callers/callees of changed symbols,
search for sensitive patterns,
impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. Outputs Write the standard review artifacts: - `outputs/pr_review.json` — structured data with `recommendation`, `summary`, `inlineComments`, `issueCounts` - `outputs/pr_review_general.md` — 1-2 paragraph general PR comment - `outputs/pr_review_comments/*.md` — one file per detailed inline comment **Inline comment lines must be present in the PR diff.** GitHub review threads can only be attached to added or context lines inside a diff hunk. If `pr_diff.txt` is truncated, run `git diff origin/{baseBranch}...HEAD` to locate the correct line numbers. Findings on unchanged code outside the diff belong in `outputs/pr_review_general.md`, not as inline comments. # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1582
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1582
- **Title**: gh-1577 [GOAL] Empty completion after truncated stream is a retryable hiccup, never a silent exit 0 (B2)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1577` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 10
- **Additions**: +983
- **Deletions**: -40
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:03:44Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T10:44:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1577
## gh-1577 — Empty completion after truncated stream is a retryable hiccup, never a silent exit 0

### What changed
- An empty assistant completion that follows partial content (assistant text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is now a **bounded-retry provider hiccup** in the agent loop; on retry exhaustion the run ends with a loud `StopReason.error` naming the hiccup, attempt count and last stop reason — headless `-p` exits 1, interactive prints the error and returns to the prompt. The silent exit-0 settle is gone.
- A clean empty (no partial content anywhere in the turn) keeps the #1085 M2b semantics exactly: one `continue` nudge per logical turn, then settle.

### Key decisions
- New pure classifier `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` (`lib/src/agent/empty_completion.dart`) with verdicts `notEmpty` / `emptyAfterPartial` / `cleanEmpty` / `abortedOrError` — shared by the loop's retry machinery and the CLI's nudge gate; the partial-content window is the TURN (messages after the last user message), so an old truncation can never resurrect retries (E1).
- Truncation signals: `StopReason.length` plus the tolerated silent-truncation `errorMessage` flag count as partial-context evidence (E6); the `ToolCall` boundary survives — thinking-only turns with tool calls are never empty (AC6/E4).
- Retry policy lives in the loop (`agent_loop_empty_completion.dart`, a `part of agent_loop.dart` to stay under the 2800-line gate): `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3, knob alongside `maxEmptyRetries`), exponential backoff in the model-roles `retry.baseDelayMs`/`maxBackoffMs` shape (500ms → 8s cap, deterministic), re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`; retried empties stay in the transcript. `CancelToken` is honored between attempts; an abort racing the classification settles `aborted` (exit 130) — never the hiccup error, never a silent empty (E2/E5).
- Exhaustion reuses `StopReason.error` (open question 2) — the existing headless exit-code switch maps it to 1 with no switch change; the legacy `maxEmptyRetries` budget and the CLI's `maxEmptyRetries: 0` wiring are untouched.
- REG-2 scope note: the never-exit-0 contract is enforced for the hiccup family (empty after partial content) across the `stop` / length-flagged / silent-truncation-flagged paths; the clean-empty settle after its one nudge keeps AC2's pinned exit-0 behavior (REG-1).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/agent/empty_completion_test.dart test/agent/agent_loop_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_empty_completion_hiccup_test.dart
dart test --exclude-tags integration   # full gate suite
```

### Test coverage
- UT-1..UT-5: classifier verdicts incl. thinking+ToolCall not empty, whitespace-only empty, backoff sequence.
- IT-1: `partial → empty → healthy` recovers and finishes (exit 0, retried empty in transcript). IT-2/E3: `partial → empty ×(N+1)` fires exactly N retries then the loud error. IT-3/REG-2: headless exhaustion exits 1 across all stop-reason variants. IT-4/AC5: interactive exhaustion returns to a steerable prompt. REG-1: clean-empty one-nudge tests unchanged.
- UT/IT run in the default CI shard (files verified bin-packed by `shard_files.py`); E2E-1 (live provider lane) and the REG required-check job wiring are CI-config follow-ups, no code dependency.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  S[assistant completion] --> C{classifyEmptyCompletion}
  C -->|notEmpty / abortedOrError| OWN[existing terminal paths]
  C -->|cleanEmpty| NUDGE[one continue nudge, then settle - #1085 M2b unchanged]
  C -->|emptyAfterPartial| R[bounded retry: N=3, backoff 500ms to 8s]
  R -->|healthy| RUN[turn continues]
  R -->|cancel| AB[settle aborted - exit 130]
  R -->|N retries spent, still empty| ERR[StopReason.error naming hiccup + attempts + last stop]
  ERR -->|headless -p| X1[exit 1]
  ERR -->|interactive| P[error line + prompt stays alive]
```
</details>
